checkedSources.detail: AFSA 'Warning on Unlicensed Digital Asset Platforms' explicitly names OKX (alongside HTX, Bitget, MEXC) as operating without required AFSA authorization. The exact warning date 2026-04-29 was not independently visible on the page at review time.

OKX Risk & Compliance Disclosure lists restricted locations (Afghanistan, Canada, Cuba, Hong Kong, Iran, India, Japan, Malaysia, Nepal, North Korea, Syria, Crimea/Donetsk/Luhansk, parts of the US) plus conditional restrictions (Australia, Bahamas, Brazil, Eritrea, Russia, South Korea, UK). Kazakhstan is absent from both lists — supports clm-kz-not-in-restricted-list.

The exact cited URL https://www.okx.com/p2p-markets/kzt/buy-usdt returned HTTP 404 at review time. Equivalent live OKX KZT P2P surfaces do exist and were confirmed (e.g. /ru/p2p-markets/kzt/buy-usdt, /p2p-markets/kzt/sell-usdt, /p2p/express/kzt/...), with active merchant offers priced in KZT. The underlying claim that a current KZT P2P surface exists is SUPPORTED; the specific citation is stale/non-resolving and should be corrected.
